name: jira-local
description: Local Jira Server integration: tickets, attachments and simple browser sign-in.

interface.shortDescription: Jira tickets and attachments with simple sign-in
interface.longDescription: Codex starts the integration automatically. The first request opens a Jira sign-in window in your browser. Your credentials and session are stored in the system credential storage, and expired sessions are renewed automatically. Your password is never sent to Codex chat.
